comment: Noise floor of npc-day-parity (docs/world-streaming.md, item 6a): on one build two full-mode days and a simplified-mode day with the same executor were byte-identical (2026-11-02, Ryzen). Any difference therefore comes from the change under test; a PR that changes the executor states its own allowance on top of this with command-line limits (for example --max-pos-p95).
